blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) has partnered with Southstar Drug to expand access to free medicines and educate Filipinos on the proper use of generic drugs. The “Kasama sa Pag-Galing” campaign, launched last month, aims to educate communities about generic medicines, prescription reading, proper over-the-counter medication use, and refill planning. READ: PhilHealth expands access to selected anti-TB drugs Southstar Drug was formally accredited as a partner pharmacy under PhilHealth’s Gamot (Guaranteed and Accessible Medications for Outpatient Treatment) benefit package under the Yaman ng Kalusugan (Yakap) program.
